title: Lời hứa
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): C-sharp minor at 72 bpm. Its motif rises a fourth (G#-C#) and goes on up, firm, as a promise is said; then again from B to E. The piano and the cellos' slow second line together from the start; then the violas join at the sentences' ends; in the middle, in E major, the violas sing the tune, the cellos answer where it holds and the piano plays sparse chords under them; the climax with the strings and the piano's rolled chords reaching E6, G#sus4 resolving to G#7; then the piano with the violas at the sentences' ends; two rising fourths to close. An original tune.
